hero.headline: Prove your worth.
hero.body: Quests are the Nexus's way of rewarding the dedicated. Collect coins, craft tiers, stake your holdings, and conquer cross-zone challenges to unlock XP, TKN, HRTG, and legendary badges.

rewardSection.headline: What you earn
rewardSection.body: Every quest rewards you with something real — XP that advances your Journey stage, TKN you can craft or trade, HRTG for the long game, and badges that mark your legend permanently.

rewardDisplay.name: XP
rewardDisplay.desc: Advances your Journey stage and unlocks new RPG abilities.

rewardDisplay.name: TKN
rewardDisplay.desc: The base currency. Craft into HRTG, GOLD, OASIS, or USGC.

rewardDisplay.name: HRTG
rewardDisplay.desc: Heritage coins. Rare, craftable, and worth 100 TKN each.

rewardDisplay.name: Badges
rewardDisplay.desc: Permanent on-chain markers of legendary achievement.

cta.headline: Ready to start?
cta.body: Connect your wallet to track progress across all quests.
